name: Tando Allahyar
purpose: City-specific cadastral and public parcel geometry investigation; registry evidence, retrieved geometry and runtime qualification are assessed separately.

queries.query: Tando Allahyar official cadastral map parcel Sindh land records GIS Pakistan
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Board of Revenue Sindh land-record portal, its ruled-card/property-card service, official GIS/geodatabase documentation, and an official Sindh education GIS page for district Tando Allahyar. The BOR documentation explicitly names Tando Allahyar among districts receiving imagery and revenue-map digitization to survey-number level, but no anonymous public parcel vector endpoint was found.

queries.query: ٹنڈو اللہ یار سرکاری زمین ریکارڈ کڈسٹرل نقشہ سندھ
queries.result: First-party-domain discovery returned the Sindh Board of Revenue public land-record/cadastral portal. The current public interface exposes land-record, deh-map, survey-register and ruled-card services, but discovery did not expose a public parcel geometry response, CRS declaration, or safe native parcel identity for Tando Allahyar.

executedQueries.query: Tando Allahyar official cadastral map parcel Sindh land records GIS Pakistan
executedQueries.result: Official Sindh BOR custodian and Tando Allahyar GIS/digitization scope found; no anonymous parcel vector response.

executedQueries.query: ٹنڈو اللہ یار سرکاری زمین ریکارڈ کڈسٹرل نقشہ سندھ
executedQueries.result: Official BOR land-record/cadastral routes found; no anonymous parcel geometry or safe native ID.

officialSources.publisher: Board of Revenue, Government of Sindh
officialSources.observation: Official public portal advertises digital land administration, property/ruled-card records, cadastral survey maps and related record services. It is not evidence by itself of an open parcel vector API.

officialSources.publisher: Board of Revenue, Government of Sindh
officialSources.observation: Current HTTP 200 ASP.NET page lists Tando Allahyar as a district option and exposes District, Taluka/Town, Ward/Quarter and Survey no selectors. The page source exposed no feature-service URL, geometry schema, CRS, or public vector response.

officialSources.publisher: Board of Revenue, Government of Sindh
officialSources.observation: Official LARMIS page states that digital district/deh maps and survey-number maps are being developed/integrated, and specifically names Tando Allahyar among districts with imagery for georeferencing and digitization of old revenue maps to survey-number level. This establishes provincial GIS/cadastral scope, not anonymous parcel download access.

officialSources.publisher: Reform Support Unit, School Education & Literacy Department, Government of Sindh
officialSources.observation: Official district GIS page loads a Google My Maps iframe for the district; the exposed map is education/infrastructure GIS, not a cadastral parcel service, and was not treated as parcel evidence.

requests.outcome: Readable current ASP.NET form. Tando Allahyar option is present; initial page has no loaded taluka/ward/survey values, no JavaScript/configured feature service, no geometry, and no CRS declaration.
Official GIS/LARMIS scope statements readable, including Tando Allahyar imagery and revenue-map digitization to survey-number level; no public parcel-vector endpoint or response schema exposed.
Official geodatabase/GIS page readable. It describes GIS mapping and spatial linkage at survey-number level but exposes no downloadable anonymous parcel vector service for this city.
Official district GIS HTML readable; its map iframe points to Google My Maps and is not a cadastral parcel API.

Official www route identified by discovery, but direct TLS fetch failed hostname verification. TLS verification was not disabled and no certificate exception was used; the non-www ruled-card route was fetched successfully.

registryBasis: Board of Revenue Sindh is an evidenced provincial land-record/cadastral custodian. Its public ruled-card service explicitly lists Tando Allahyar, and official BOR GIS documentation explicitly names Tando Allahyar in survey-number-level revenue-map digitization scope.

sourceCandidate.publisher: Board of Revenue, Government of Sindh
sourceCandidate.scope: Sindh public record service; Tando Allahyar record coverage is evidenced by selector option, but anonymous geometry access is unverified
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identity if source-proven

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Sindh provincial land records, deh maps, survey registers and GIS/revenue maps, with official Tando Allahyar survey-number digitization scope
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Provincial custodian, Tando Allahyar selector coverage and official GIS scope only; citywide parcel polygon coverage, CRS, schema, native identity and anonymous API access remain unverified.

remainingUncertainty: The Board of Revenue may hold Tando Allahyar city-survey/deh geometry behind selector workflows or non-indexed services, but the current anonymous public routes exposed no safe vector response. An empty selector state, TLS hostname failure, or lack of an exact-point hit was not treated as citywide absence.
pointBasis: Exact immutable WUP queue point; not shifted to force a parcel hit.
packetNote: Research packet completion is not source integration, adapter admission, or runtime qualification. No retained GeoJSON sample was created because no safe native parcel identity and full parcel geometry were verified.
